d: Taly is a Kuwaiti, Sharia-compliant Buy Now, Pay Later company licensed by the Central Bank of Kuwait (CBK). It was the first Kuwaiti BNPL company to join the CBK regulatory sandbox in 2022 and received its CBK license in 2025.

Customers shop online or in store and split purchases into four equal installments, free of interest and fees, or pay later. Partners include Kuwait Finance House, Kuwait Airways and LuLu Hypermarket.

Our engineering team builds the platform behind every checkout: Java microservices for accounts, authentication, merchants, credit decisions, notifications and the back office, and TypeScript front ends for consumers, merchants and operations. Services connect to Ci-Net, Kuwait's credit bureau, and run on Kubernetes.

You'll secure Taly's cloud, Kubernetes platform and delivery pipelines, and build security into how we ship. You'll work with DevOps and engineers every day, and with the information security team on detection and response.
q: About 4–6 years in security, DevOps, SRE or cloud engineering, including at least 2 years focused on security.
Fintech, payments or banking experience is strongly preferred.
Fluent English; Arabic is a plus.
IAM: least-privilege policies, permission boundaries, SCPs, MFA enforcement, access reviews and cross-account roles.
Web application firewalls: managed and custom rules, rate limiting, bot and account-takeover protection, and reading WAF logs to tell false positives from attacks.
Detection and audit: AWS audit logging, threat detection, configuration compliance and alerting services.
Data protection: key management, storage access policies, encryption at rest and in transit, and backup and replication.
Network: VPC design, security groups, NACLs, private endpoints, TLS and certificate management, and secure connectivity.
Cluster hardening: RBAC, Pod Security Standards, network policies, workload identity and secrets handling.
Container image security: minimal base images, image scanning, and image signing and provenance.
Node management: node autoscaling and OS image patching.
Pipeline security: secure workflow design, short-lived cloud credentials (OIDC) instead of static keys, and secrets hygiene.
Source code protection: branch protections, code ownership rules, dependency updates, secret scanning, push protection and code scanning.
GitOps: declarative deployments with promotion and approval gates for production.
Pipeline security testing: SAST, DAST, SCA and IaC scanning tools.
Incident response: log forensics across cloud audit, WAF, load balancer and network flow logs, containment, credential rotation and post-incident hardening.
SIEM: log integration, detection rules and alert triage.
Vulnerability management: running enterprise vulnerability scanners, CVE prioritisation and remediation SLA tracking.
Secrets and certificates: secrets vaults, rotation and certificate lifecycle management.
Hands-on PCI DSS v4.0: scoping, segmentation, evidence collection and working with a QSA.
Familiarity with ISO 27001 controls and regulator expectations; Central Bank of Kuwait or GCC fintech regulation is a plus.
Bash and Python for automation and log analysis, and fluency with the AWS CLI and SDKs.
Enough Java/Spring Boot to review code and find security issues, since our backend runs on it.
Infrastructure as code: modules, remote state security, drift detection and policy as code.
Zero-trust access tools for server, Kubernetes and database access with session recording.
Application security testing and threat modelling for APIs, including the OWASP API Top 10, OAuth 2.0/OIDC and JWT.
Mobile app security for iOS and Android: certificate pinning, root and jailbreak detection, and OWASP MASVS.
Observability tools such as Prometheus and Grafana.
Linux server hardening to CIS benchmarks.
Certifications: AWS Security Specialty, CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), OSCP or CISSP.
r: Cloud security: identity, network, data protection and threat detection in AWS.
Kubernetes and containers: cluster hardening, image security and node patching.
CI/CD and supply chain: pipeline security, source code protection and secure deployments.
Security operations: incident response, SIEM integration and vulnerability management.
Compliance: PCI DSS v4.0, ISO 27001 and Central Bank of Kuwait requirements.
Harden and monitor cloud accounts across identity, network, encryption, logging and threat detection.
Tune web application firewall and bot protection rules, and separate real attacks from false positives.
Harden Kubernetes clusters, container images and nodes, including access control, workload isolation and patching.
Secure CI/CD pipelines and source code repositories, and build SAST, DAST, SCA, IaC and secret scanning into every pipeline.
Own security gates for production deployments, including promotion and approval controls.
Lead technical incident response: log forensics, containment, credential rotation and post-incident hardening.
Integrate logs with the SIEM and triage security alerts.
Run vulnerability scanning, prioritise CVEs and track remediation SLAs with engineering teams.
Manage secrets, key rotation and certificate lifecycles.
Maintain PCI DSS scoping and segmentation, collect evidence and support QSA assessments.
Automate security checks and log analysis, and review Java/Spring Boot code for security issues.
